sourceEditions.label: EveryonePiano 1896 / Ritchie, parallel numbered and staff notation of one arrangement
sourceEditions.tempoEvidence: The numbered page prints quarter=112; the staff page confirms pitches and articulation but prints no numeric tempo.
sourceEditions.mapping: Right-hand/upper melody of every printed m1–17; app beat = (measure - 1) * 4 + quarter-beat offset. Read the explicit melody voice, not the highest note of an accompaniment chord.
sourceEditions.independence: Numbered and staff pages are parallel representations of the same arrangement, not two independent musical sources. A visually matching repost is not independent corroboration.

currentScopeReview.notationDecision: All five explicit same-pitch ties are one attack each. Four previously split ties are merged; the existing A3@28/5 tie across m8–9 is retained. E4@6.5 and A3@33 are separate following attacks. G4@43/.75 and G4@43.75/.25 are genuine separate attacks; the m7 B3@27 to C4@27.75 different-pitch slur keeps both attacks.

sourceForm.scope: Complete visible short arrangement, not the complete film score or an exact recording transcription.

currentScopeReview.sourceTotalBeatsMeaning: 68 quarter-note beats in the reviewed 17-bar short arrangement. The last A3 sounds from 64 through 68; no ending rest, added pickup or repeat is implied.

transposition.decision: One interval-preserving global shift maps the complete right-hand melody into the fixed 21-key natural-note vocabulary; source Bb maps to F, rather than being replaced with a neighboring source natural.

currentScopeReview.retainedPracticeTempo: 112 BPM agrees with the printed numbered-source quarter=112. The unchanged 0.82 default suggests 91.84 BPM, not the actual selected/remembered runtime speed.

accompanimentReview.decision: The preserved V2 still has 60 explicit melody attacks and 26 automatic accompaniment events. Its old melody is incompatible with the reviewed 56-attack V1; do not borrow its backing. No harmony or new support is approved.
